image.why: The real river in Epirus that the Greeks believed flowed down to the underworld

summary.en: A river in Epirus, north-west Greece, which Greek myth made the entrance to the underworld: the river across which Charon ferried the souls of the dead.

en: Flows through Epirus to the Ionian Sea
Roman poets often give Charon's role to the Styx instead
